verdict.rationale: Sift documents Workflows as "a powerful rules automation platform" for making risk-based decisions in real time during key events [sift-docs-12, sift-docs-6]. Custom Decisions such as Ban Account or Cancel Order connect those outcomes to real business actions in your backend [sift-docs-7, sift-docs-3]. An early HN comment from the CEO said the product had no rules [sift-comm-8], but it describes the product's original ML-only stance rather than a hands-on failure of Workflows, so it lowers confidence without creating a dispute. Missing for 10: detail on rule condition syntax and supported event triggers, documentation of how actions are executed automatically (e.g. webhooks or backend callbacks), independent or hands-on corroboration that Workflows work as described.
